summary: Implementation plan to (1) make CurrentlyReadingCard swipeable using the shared 3-slot GPU-composited BookSwipeDeck with pointer/touch drag and a compact 1/N chevron stepper, (2) unify CurrentlyReadingCard across both the Reading Room Dashboard and LibraryOverview, and (3) eliminate the 5-minute client cache lag when updating reading status via a centralized optimistic cache patcher and cross-query invalidation helper.
